{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011CgwRvhbbffJacWYemKrgW","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The Checkout button was missing because the Cart screen only showed it when the persisted `newCheckout` flag was true. This device had a stale stored `flags` value with `newCheckout: false`, and nothing in the app code writes it. That value overrode the default of `true` and hid the button. I changed `src/screens/Cart.tsx` so Checkout shows whenever the cart has items, and removed the flag check and its import.
